verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י מוֹאָ֔ב וְעַל־ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַל־ שָׂרְפ֛וֹ עַצְמ֥וֹת מֶֽלֶךְ־ אֱד֖וֹם לַשִּֽׂיד׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ‘al- šə·lō·šāh piš·‘ê mō·w·’āḇ wə·‘al- ’ar·bā·‘āh lō ’ă·šî·ḇen·nū ‘al- śā·rə·p̄ōw ‘aṣ·mō·wṯ me·leḵ- ’ĕ·ḏō·wm laś·śîḏ
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says For three transgressions of Moab even four I will not revoke My judgment because he burned to lime the bones of Edom’s king
verses.literalPt: Assim diz Jeová: Por causa de três transgressões de Moabe, sim, de quatro, não desviarei o seu castigo, porque queimou os ossos do rei de Edom até os reduzir em cinza.

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי־ אֵ֣שׁ בְּמוֹאָ֔ב וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנ֣וֹת הַקְּרִיּ֑וֹת וּמֵ֤ת בְּשָׁאוֹן֙ מוֹאָ֔ב בִּתְרוּעָ֖ה בְּק֥וֹל שׁוֹפָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šil·laḥ·tî- ’êš bə·mō·w·’āḇ wə·’ā·ḵə·lāh ’ar·mə·nō·wṯ haq·qə·rî·yō·wṯ ū·mêṯ bə·šā·’ō·wn mō·w·’āḇ biṯ·rū·‘āh bə·qō·wl šō·w·p̄ār
verses.literal: So I will send fire against Moab to consume the citadels of Kerioth Moab will die in tumult amid war cries and the sound of the ram’s horn
verses.literalPt: Porém meterei a Moabe um fogo que devorará os palácios de Queriote; Moabe perecerá com tumulto, com alarido e com sonido das trombetas.

verses.original: וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י שׁוֹפֵ֖ט מִקִּרְבָּ֑הּ וְכָל־ שָׂרֶ֛יהָ אֶהֱר֥וֹג עִמּ֖וֹ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hiḵ·rat·tî šō·w·p̄êṭ miq·qir·bāh wə·ḵāl śā·re·hā ’e·hĕ·rō·wḡ ‘im·mōw ’ā·mar Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will cut off the ruler of Moab and kill all the officials with him says the LORD
verses.literalPt: Do meio dele exterminarei o juízo e farei morrer com ele todos os seus príncipes, diz Jeová.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וְעַל־ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַֽל־ מָאֳסָ֞ם אֶת־ תּוֹרַ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה וְחֻקָּיו֙ לֹ֣א שָׁמָ֔רוּ וַיַּתְעוּם֙ כִּזְבֵיהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ הָלְכ֥וּ אֲבוֹתָ֖ם אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ‘al- šə·lō·šāh piš·‘ê yə·hū·ḏāh wə·‘al- ’ar·bā·‘āh lō ’ă·šî·ḇen·nū ‘al- mā·’o·sām ’eṯ- tō·w·raṯ Yah·weh wə·ḥuq·qāw lō šā·mā·rū way·yaṯ·‘ūm kiz·ḇê·hem ’ă·šer- hā·lə·ḵū ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām ’a·ḥă·rê·hem
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says For three transgressions of Judah even four I will not revoke My judgment because they reject the Law of the LORD and fail to keep His statutes they are led astray by the lies in which their fathers walked . . .
verses.literalPt: Assim diz Jeová: Por causa de três transgressões de Judá, sim, de quatro, não desviarei o seu castigo, porque rejeitaram a lei de Jeová, não guardaram os seus estatutos, e os fizeram errar as suas mentiras, após as quais andaram seus pais.

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי אֵ֖שׁ בִּֽיהוּדָ֑ה וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנ֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃פ
verses.literal: So I will send fire upon Judah to consume the citadels of Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Porém meterei a Judá um fogo que devorará os palácios de Jerusalém.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְעַל־ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַל־ מִכְרָ֤ם בַּכֶּ֙סֶף֙ צַדִּ֔יק וְאֶבְי֖וֹן בַּעֲב֥וּר נַעֲלָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ‘al- šə·lō·šāh piš·‘ê yiś·rā·’êl wə·‘al- ’ar·bā·‘āh lō ’ă·šî·ḇen·nū ‘al- miḵ·rām bak·ke·sep̄ ṣad·dîq wə·’eḇ·yō·wn ba·‘ă·ḇūr na·‘ă·lā·yim
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says For three transgressions of Israel even four I will not revoke My judgment because they sell the righteous for silver and the needy for a pair of sandals
verses.literalPt: Assim diz Jeová: Por causa de três transgressões de Israel, sim, de quatro, não desviarei o seu castigo, porque venderam o justo por dinheiro e o necessitado, por um par de sapatos.

verses.original: הַשֹּׁאֲפִ֤ים עַל־ עֲפַר־ אֶ֙רֶץ֙ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ דַּלִּ֔ים וְדֶ֥רֶךְ עֲנָוִ֖ים יַטּ֑וּ וְאִ֣ישׁ וְאָבִ֗יו יֵֽלְכוּ֙ אֶל־ הַֽנַּעֲרָ֔ה לְמַ֥עַן חַלֵּ֖ל אֶת־ שֵׁ֥ם קָדְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: haš·šō·’ă·p̄îm ‘al- ‘ă·p̄ar- ’e·reṣ bə·rōš dal·lîm wə·ḏe·reḵ ‘ă·nā·wîm yaṭ·ṭū wə·’îš wə·’ā·ḇîw yê·lə·ḵū ’el- han·na·‘ă·rāh lə·ma·‘an ḥal·lêl ’eṯ- šêm qāḏ·šî
verses.literal: They trample on the heads of the poor as on the dust of the earth they push the needy out of their way A man and his father have relations with . . . the same girl and so profane My holy name
verses.literalPt: Eles suspiram pelo pó da terra sobre a cabeça dos pobres e pervertem o caminho dos mansos. Um homem e seu pai entrarão à mesma moça, para profanarem o meu santo nome.

verses.original: וְעַל־ בְּגָדִ֤ים חֲבֻלִים֙ יַטּ֔וּ אֵ֖צֶל כָּל־ מִזְבֵּ֑חַ וְיֵ֤ין עֲנוּשִׁים֙ יִשְׁתּ֔וּ בֵּ֖ית אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- bə·ḡā·ḏîm ḥă·ḇu·lîm yaṭ·ṭū ’ê·ṣel kāl- miz·bê·aḥ wə·yên ‘ă·nū·šîm yiš·tū bêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem
verses.literal: They lie down beside every altar on garments taken in pledge And in the house of their God they drink wine obtained through fines
verses.literalPt: Ao lado de todos os altares, deitam-se sobre roupas recebidas em penhor e, na casa do seu Deus, bebem o vinho dos que têm sido multados.

verses.original: וְאָ֨נֹכִ֜י הִשְׁמַ֤דְתִּי אֶת־ הָֽאֱמֹרִי֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר כְּגֹ֤בַהּ אֲרָזִים֙ גָּבְה֔וֹ וְחָסֹ֥ן ה֖וּא כָּֽאַלּוֹנִ֑ים וָאַשְׁמִ֤יד פִּרְיוֹ֙ מִמַּ֔עַל וְשָׁרָשָׁ֖יו מִתָּֽחַת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·nō·ḵî hiš·maḏ·tî ’eṯ- hā·’ĕ·mō·rî mip·pə·nê·hem ’ă·šer kə·ḡō·ḇah ’ă·rā·zîm gā·ḇə·hōw wə·ḥā·sōn hū kā·’al·lō·w·nîm wā·’aš·mîḏ pir·yōw mim·ma·‘al wə·šā·rā·šāw mit·tā·ḥaṯ
verses.literal: Yet it was I who destroyed the Amorite before them though his height was like that of the cedars and he was as strong as the oaks Yet I destroyed his fruit above and his roots below
verses.literalPt: Todavia, eu destruí diante deles o amorreu, cuja altura era como a altura dos cedros, e ele mesmo, forte como os carvalhos; destruí o seu fruto por cima e as suas raízes, por baixo.

verses.original: וְאָנֹכִ֛י הֶעֱלֵ֥יתִי אֶתְכֶ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וָאוֹלֵ֨ךְ אֶתְכֶ֤ם בַּמִּדְבָּר֙ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה לָרֶ֖שֶׁת אֶת־ אֶ֥רֶץ הָאֱמֹרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·nō·ḵî he·‘ĕ·lê·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim wā·’ō·w·lêḵ ’eṯ·ḵem bam·miḏ·bār ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh lā·re·šeṯ ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ hā·’ĕ·mō·rî
verses.literal: And I brought you up from the land of Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness that you might take possession of the land of the Amorite
verses.literalPt: Também eu vos fiz subir da terra do Egito e, quarenta anos, vos guiei no deserto para que possuísseis a terra do amorreu.

verses.original: וָאָקִ֤ים מִבְּנֵיכֶם֙ לִנְבִיאִ֔ים וּמִבַּחוּרֵיכֶ֖ם לִנְזִרִ֑ים הַאַ֥ף אֵֽין־ זֹ֛את בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ā·qîm mib·bə·nê·ḵem lin·ḇî·’îm ū·mib·ba·ḥū·rê·ḵem lin·zi·rîm ha·’ap̄ ’ên- zōṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: I raised up prophets from your sons and Nazirites from your young men Is this not true O children of Israel declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: De vossos filhos suscitei profetas e, de vossos mancebos, nazireus. Pois não é assim, filhos de Israel? — diz Jeová.

verses.original: וַתַּשְׁק֥וּ אֶת־ הַנְּזִרִ֖ים יָ֑יִן וְעַל־ הַנְּבִיאִים֙ צִוִּיתֶ֣ם לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹ֖א תִּנָּבְאֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·taš·qū ’eṯ- han·nə·zi·rîm yā·yin wə·‘al- han·nə·ḇî·’îm ṣiw·wî·ṯem lê·mōr lō tin·nā·ḇə·’ū
verses.literal: But you made the Nazirites drink wine . . . and commanded . . . the prophets not to prophesy
verses.literalPt: Mas aos nazireus destes vinho a beber e ordenastes aos profetas, dizendo: Não profetizeis.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה אָנֹכִ֥י מֵעִ֖יק תַּחְתֵּיכֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר תָּעִיק֙ הָעֲגָלָ֔ה הַֽמְלֵאָ֥ה לָ֖הּ עָמִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî mê·‘îq taḥ·tê·ḵem ka·’ă·šer tā·‘îq hā·‘ă·ḡā·lāh ham·lê·’āh lāh ‘ā·mîr
verses.literal: Behold I am about to crush you in your place as with a cart full of grain
verses.literalPt: Eis que eu vos apertarei no vosso lugar, como se aperta o carro que está cheio de feixes.

verses.original: וְאָבַ֤ד מָנוֹס֙ מִקָּ֔ל וְחָזָ֖ק לֹא־ יְאַמֵּ֣ץ כֹּח֑וֹ וְגִבּ֖וֹר לֹא־ יְמַלֵּ֥ט נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·ḇaḏ mā·nō·ws miq·qāl wə·ḥā·zāq lō- yə·’am·mêṣ kō·ḥōw wə·ḡib·bō·wr lō- yə·mal·lêṭ nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: Escape will fail the swift the strong will not prevail by his strength and the mighty will not save his life
verses.literalPt: Faltará refúgio ao ligeiro, e o forte não corroborará a sua força, nem o valente se livrará a si mesmo;

verses.original: וְתֹפֵ֤שׂ הַקֶּ֙שֶׁת֙ לֹ֣א יַעֲמֹ֔ד וְקַ֥ל בְּרַגְלָ֖יו לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּ֑ט וְרֹכֵ֣ב הַסּ֔וּס לֹ֥א יְמַלֵּ֖ט נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṯō·p̄êś haq·qe·šeṯ lō ya·‘ă·mōḏ wə·qal bə·raḡ·lāw lō yə·mal·lêṭ wə·rō·ḵêḇ has·sūs lō yə·mal·lêṭ nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: The archer . . . will not stand his ground the fleet of foot will not escape and the horseman . . . will not save his life
verses.literalPt: nem ficará em pé aquele que maneja o arco. Aquele que é ligeiro de pés não se livrará; nem se livrará o que vai montado a cavalo;

verses.original: וְאַמִּ֥יץ לִבּ֖וֹ בַּגִּבּוֹרִ֑ים עָר֛וֹם יָנ֥וּס בַּיּוֹם־ הַה֖וּא נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’am·mîṣ lib·bōw bag·gib·bō·w·rîm ‘ā·rō·wm yā·nūs bay·yō·wm- ha·hū nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Even the bravest of mighty men will flee naked on that day declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: e aquele que é corajoso entre os valentes fugirá nu naquele dia, diz Jeová.
